targets.rawSql: SELECT host_name || ':' || device_id AS device, 100.0 * EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM SUM(LEAST(COALESCE(ended_at, NOW()), $__timeTo()::timestamptz) - GREATEST(started_at, $__timeFrom()::timestamptz))) / NULLIF(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM ($__timeTo()::timestamptz - $__timeFrom()::timestamptz)), 0) AS occupancy FROM (SELECT * FROM device_control_sessions WHERE ('${flag}' = '__ALL__' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM device_flags df WHERE df.host_name = device_control_sessions.host_name AND df.device_id = device_control_sessions.device_id AND df.flags && string_to_array('${flag:csv}', ',')))) device_control_sessions WHERE started_at < $__timeTo()::timestamptz AND COALESCE(ended_at, NOW()) > $__timeFrom()::timestamptz GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: Busy vs idle repartition per device

targets.rawSql: WITH agg AS (SELECT host_name || ':' || device_id AS device, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM SUM(CASE WHEN owner_type = 'manual_control' THEN LEAST(COALESCE(ended_at, NOW()), $__timeTo()::timestamptz) - GREATEST(started_at, $__timeFrom()::timestamptz) ELSE interval '0' END)) AS manual_s, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM SUM(CASE WHEN owner_type <> 'manual_control' THEN LEAST(COALESCE(ended_at, NOW()), $__timeTo()::timestamptz) - GREATEST(started_at, $__timeFrom()::timestamptz) ELSE interval '0' END)) AS script_s, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM ($__timeTo()::timestamptz - $__timeFrom()::timestamptz)) AS range_s FROM (SELECT * FROM device_control_sessions WHERE ('${flag}' = '__ALL__' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM device_flags df WHERE df.host_name = device_control_sessions.host_name AND df.device_id = device_control_sessions.device_id AND df.flags && string_to_array('${flag:csv}', ',')))) device_control_sessions WHERE started_at < $__timeTo()::timestamptz AND COALESCE(ended_at, NOW()) > $__timeFrom()::timestamptz GROUP BY 1) SELECT device, ROUND((100.0 * manual_s / range_s)::numeric, 2) AS manual, ROUND((100.0 * script_s / range_s)::numeric, 2) AS script, ROUND((100.0 * GREATEST(0, range_s - manual_s - script_s) / range_s)::numeric, 2) AS idle FROM agg ORDER BY 1

SELECT owner_type, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM SUM(LEAST(COALESCE(ended_at, NOW()), $__timeTo()::timestamptz) - GREATEST(started_at, $__timeFrom()::timestamptz)))::bigint AS seconds FROM (SELECT * FROM device_control_sessions WHERE ('${flag}' = '__ALL__' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM device_flags df WHERE df.host_name = device_control_sessions.host_name AND df.device_id = device_control_sessions.device_id AND df.flags && string_to_array('${flag:csv}', ',')))) device_control_sessions WHERE started_at < $__timeTo()::timestamptz AND COALESCE(ended_at, NOW()) > $__timeFrom()::timestamptz GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

SELECT COALESCE(p.full_name, p.email, 'user-' || LEFT(s.owner_user_id, 8), 'unknown') AS "user", EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM SUM(LEAST(COALESCE(s.ended_at, NOW()), $__timeTo()::timestamptz) - GREATEST(s.started_at, $__timeFrom()::timestamptz)))::bigint AS seconds FROM (SELECT * FROM device_control_sessions WHERE ('${flag}' = '__ALL__' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM device_flags df WHERE df.host_name = device_control_sessions.host_name AND df.device_id = device_control_sessions.device_id AND df.flags && string_to_array('${flag:csv}', ',')))) s LEFT JOIN profiles p ON p.id::text = s.owner_user_id WHERE s.owner_type = 'manual_control' AND s.started_at < $__timeTo()::timestamptz AND COALESCE(s.ended_at, NOW()) > $__timeFrom()::timestamptz GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

SELECT b.bucket AS time, s.host_name || ':' || s.device_id AS device, MAX(s.owner_type) AS state FROM (SELECT generate_series($__timeFrom()::timestamptz, $__timeTo()::timestamptz, interval '$__interval') AS bucket) b JOIN (SELECT * FROM device_control_sessions WHERE ('${flag}' = '__ALL__' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM device_flags df WHERE df.host_name = device_control_sessions.host_name AND df.device_id = device_control_sessions.device_id AND df.flags && string_to_array('${flag:csv}', ',')))) s ON s.started_at < b.bucket + interval '$__interval' AND COALESCE(s.ended_at, NOW()) > b.bucket GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

WITH buckets AS (SELECT generate_series(date_trunc('hour', $__timeFrom()::timestamptz), $__timeTo()::timestamptz, interval '1 hour') AS bucket) SELECT b.bucket AS time, s.host_name || ':' || s.device_id AS metric, LEAST(100.0, 100.0 * EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM SUM(LEAST(COALESCE(s.ended_at, NOW()), b.bucket + interval '1 hour') - GREATEST(s.started_at, b.bucket))) / 3600.0) AS occupancy FROM buckets b JOIN (SELECT * FROM device_control_sessions WHERE ('${flag}' = '__ALL__' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM device_flags df WHERE df.host_name = device_control_sessions.host_name AND df.device_id = device_control_sessions.device_id AND df.flags && string_to_array('${flag:csv}', ',')))) s ON s.started_at < b.bucket + interval '1 hour' AND COALESCE(s.ended_at, NOW()) > b.bucket GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

SELECT s.started_at, s.ended_at, s.host_name, s.device_id, s.owner_type, s.end_reason, s.lock_reason, COALESCE(p.full_name, p.email, s.owner_user_id) AS "user", EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (COALESCE(s.ended_at, NOW()) - s.started_at))::bigint AS duration FROM (SELECT * FROM device_control_sessions WHERE ('${flag}' = '__ALL__' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM device_flags df WHERE df.host_name = device_control_sessions.host_name AND df.device_id = device_control_sessions.device_id AND df.flags && string_to_array('${flag:csv}', ',')))) s LEFT JOIN profiles p ON p.id::text = s.owner_user_id WHERE $__timeFilter(s.started_at) ORDER BY s.started_at DESC LIMIT 300

panels.title: Script occupancy % by device — script_results
panels.description: Computed from script_results started_at/completed_at; useful for ranges before device_control_sessions collection began (2026-07-15). Scripts only — manual sessions were not tracked.

targets.rawSql: SELECT host_name || ':' || COALESCE(device_name, 'device1') AS device, 100.0 * EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM SUM(LEAST(completed_at, $__timeTo()::timestamptz) - GREATEST(started_at, $__timeFrom()::timestamptz))) / NULLIF(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM ($__timeTo()::timestamptz - $__timeFrom()::timestamptz)), 0) AS occupancy FROM (SELECT * FROM script_results WHERE ('${flag}' = '__ALL__' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM device_flags df WHERE df.host_name = script_results.host_name AND df.device_name = script_results.device_name AND df.flags && string_to_array('${flag:csv}', ',')))) script_results WHERE started_at < $__timeTo()::timestamptz AND completed_at > $__timeFrom()::timestamptz GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC
